description: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 21, plans to issue a Request for Quote (RFQ) for Exhaust Hood and Grease Trap Cleaning Services for VA Central California Health Care System (VACCHCS) in accordance with the performance work statement contained herein. The solicitation number for this RFQ is 36C26126Q0560. The solicitation will be issued on or about April 13th, 2026, with an anticipated due date of April 27th, 2026. The North American Industry Classification Systems (NAICS) is 561790, size standard $9M. Contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov. Please send any questions or inquires to Lacy.Morgan@va.gov.
